children: Long Wing Aviation Technology (00918) said Zhang Chen has been appointed chief marketing officer, effective December 7, 2026, according to ETNet.

The company said Zhang, 37, has more than 10 years of experience in large-scale property development, high-end hotel cluster operations and integrated fire engineering construction. He previously served as general manager at several companies, including Anhui Meilian Real Estate Development, Nantong Chengde Real Estate Development, Bengbu Jiayue Hotel Management and Jiangsu Shentian Construction.
Long Wing Aviation Technology said Zhang's experience could support the faster rollout of its advanced firefighting drone technology in regional markets and help build a commercial customer network.

title: Long Wing Aviation Technology Appoints Zhang Chen As Chief Marketing Officer
